rules_applied: Never imply Amazon endorses, sponsors or reviews this site.
Do not use the Amazon logo, the smile mark, or 'Amazon' in the site name, logo, domain or social handles.
Refer to the retailer as 'Amazon' in body copy only, never as a badge or endorsement.
Do not state or imply a price in social copy — prices change and stale prices are a terms violation.
Every social post and every page carries an affiliate disclosure.
